experiments.question: Does operation-specific basis + selection + projection + capability validation avoid the false-reject cost of a universal version lock while preserving constructed safety?

construction.unsafe_definition: any required basis dimension changed OR selector corrupted OR projection corrupted OR capability invalid

experiments.interpretation: In this constructed workload, a universal all-dimension lock is safe but rejects substantial harmless unrelated churn. Operation-specific validation preserves constructed safety with much higher acceptance. Omitting selection integrity reopens an unsafe channel that scales with selector corruption. The numeric rates are workload parameters/proxy outcomes, not FRANK prevalence or production safety estimates.
experiments.boundary: synthetic mechanism + independent runtime replication only; target live/twin FRANK remains required
